dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Allow me to offer my blessings to the brave warriors who have entered the Domain.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Wounds are not an apt reward for such tribulation... May their pain be soothed by the moonlight.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: And may the blessings of the Frostmoon be true to you.
